answer_1.quote: We explore the hypothesis that large pretrained text-to-text models like T5 already contain a strong representation of textual style, which can be extracted and used to condition the decoder of a style transfer model...
answer_1.outputs: style-modified sentences (e.g., sentiment, formality, dialect changes)

answer_2.quote: To estimate the sentiment of the output, we fine-tune a BERT-Large classifier... For content preservation, we calculate self-BLEU between the output and input... report "G-score" (the geometric mean of accuracy and content) as a summary of overall model quality.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluations of the three strongest models... We sample 200 examples per transfer direction... on three metrics: sentiment transfer (how well the model changed the sentiment), content preservation, and fluency, on scales of 1-5.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to rate sentiment transfer, content preservation, and fluency on a 1‑5 scale.
